dataset_name: Budget vs Actual Variance Navigator - Canonical Intelligence Data

transformation.method: Each of the 18 source observations is expanded into four canonical financial measurement records: budget, actual, committed, and forecast. The resulting 72 rows are measurements derived from 18 observations, not 72 independent transactions.
transformation.forecast_limitation: forecast_amount values are illustrative figures inherited from the source dataset. They are not generated by, or validated against, a predictive forecasting model.
